__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

path_prefix.description: Exact string prefix; no URL/path normalization.

templated_groups.description: Groups across every page that carry at least one templated segment.

include_query_parameter_names.description: Include distinct observed query parameter names and their original record ordinals; names do not establish required parameters or a complete API schema.

origin.description: Primary origin: the origin with the most JSON-like records.

name.description: Kebab-case environment name derived from the primary origin host.

api_surface_template.description: Four-rule template of the tool's earliest record.

records.description: Pointers to the retained parent records cited by tools; no bodies.

templated_groups.description: Tools and excluded groups that carry at least one templated segment.

template_rules.description: Opt-in template rules applied after the four format rules, each listed at most once: after-uid-literal templates the segment following a literal uid, opaque-token templates long mixed alphanumeric segments, sibling-variance merges groups that differ in one identifier-like segment, sibling-pair-variance merges groups that differ in two adjacent literals between a plural literal and another literal when at least three distinct pairs vary in both, prefix-variance templates a literal at a position another tool templates by one of the other opt-in rules after the same preceding segments, at any method or length, when the literal is one of that parameter's observed values, carries a digit and has the length and character classes of one, or has the single length (eight or more characters) every observed value has and only their character classes. Literal sibling folding into existing opt-in parameters also requires sibling-variance. Merged parameters are inferences.

include_query_parameter_names.description: Include distinct observed query parameter names per tool; names do not establish required parameters or a complete API schema.

timeline.description: Records are ordered by recorded start time, or by record order when any start time is missing.

id_basis.description: path-parameter: item responses repeat the requested path value in this field; field-name: inferred from listed items as the first identity name, else the first field ending in Id or _id shown distinct across at least two items, that every listed item carries distinctly.

init_before_ordinal.description: First recorded write whose path root relates to the type; state comes from records that finished before it.

volatile_fields.description: Fields whose recorded values changed with no recorded write between; the state keeps the latest.

entities.description: Entities in collection order: type, collection, then first sighting.

envelope_ordinal.description: Record whose response, with the entity object replaced, every item response shares.

membership.description: all: every entity of the collection in state order; recorded: the entities each recorded response listed, except on the lines all_record_ordinals names.

all_record_ordinals.description: With recorded membership, the checked lines that each listed every entity of their collection in state order, with only paging parameters starting at zero; a call answered on one lists the whole collection. Absent when none does.

counters.description: Envelope members that count the listed entities: a top-level member's name, or a JSON pointer to one in a top-level object beside the list (`/pageInfo/totalRows`); a top-level name starting with `/` is written as its pointer (`/~1total`).

query.description: How the view's other checked lines select and order entities, when filters, a search, a sort or paging explain them; absent when none does.

writes.description: One plan per tool whose method may change state: its modelled effect, and whether the capture's later reads confirmed it (served).

write_clock.description: The instant a served clock starts from: the end of the capture's last timed record.

template_rules.description: Opt-in template rules as for environment-manifest, each listed at most once. Use the rules of the manifest the state accompanies so tool names match.

state.description: Read tools answered from the state.

recorded.description: Read tools that replay their recordings.

recorded_reasons.description: Replayed read tools per reason, as the environment-state view names the reasons.

hint.description: What to record next; advice that never changes what is served.

exemplar_ordinal.description: The first successful recorded call the plan was built from.

contradicted_by.description: The read that disagreed with the modelled effect.

template_rules.description: Opt-in template rules as for environment-manifest, each listed at most once. Use the rules of the manifest the environment serves so tool names match.

mi.description: The console command's independently framed MI result record; empty when a separate read-only query proves completion but raw stdout prevents identifying the original result class.

preview_truncated.description: More retained files have probe issues than fit in the preview.

name.description: Exact architecture name selected from lipo output; null when selection is unknown.

container_file_offset.description: Offset of the selected slice from the start of the input Mach-O container; null when unknown.

path.description: Selected artifact path; empty when explicitly excluded from Evidence.

sha256.description: Observed SHA-256; null only when explicitly excluded.

limitations: This Evidence predates the manifest component projection; run inspect_android_package again to obtain it.

available.description: Provider facet_availability for pseudocode when declared; otherwise whether decompiled text is present. The flag is authoritative over raw length.

code_units.description: Pseudocode length in UTF-16 code units, the unit inspect_analysis_view pages pseudocode by.

truncated.description: True only when value-flow is available and the provider truncated it; false when value-flow is unavailable (see available).

facet_availability.description: The provider's declared availability per facet, or null when it declared none. Unavailable facets name their reason here and in unknowns.

path.description: Exact node path; required for properties and optional for nodes

fields.description: Select record fields; address and source_index preserve identity. Selecting value also retains its string and decoding qualifications. Omit for every recorded field. Search tools filter before retention.

encoding_status.description: Whether the provider declares the encoding or REA infers it from the typed bytes and native display. This does not establish the original source's intended encoding.

provider_value.description: Original provider display text, which may shorten the typed object.

decoding.description: When present, value retains native display text because typed bytes could not be decoded.

protobuf.description: Flat decoding facts for explicitly selected records. Field indices are local to a body; offset_basis states whether ranges refer to retained or base64-decoded bytes. Interpretations without a caller-supplied schema are candidates.

fields.description: Original index always retained. Default attributes omit dependency vectors; select dependencies explicitly for direct index references.

path.description: Exact observed module path or original source-map reference from a module page; an empty reference is valid.

paths.description: Exact Evidence artifact-path or source-range source strings. Omitted includes unknown locations; [] matches none. No filesystem lookup or path normalization.

property_keys.description: Exact retained observation-property names to read; [] requests identities/provenance only. Missing properties remain omitted, distinct from retained null. No cross-observation merging or inferred values.

include_available_property_keys.description: Opt into original property names for each returned observation, without unselected values. Use with property_keys: [] to discover fields before reading them.

file_offset.description: LC_MAIN entry offset from the start of the selected Mach-O slice.
Offset from the start of the input Mach-O container.
Offset from the start of the selected Mach-O slice.
Offset from the start of the selected Mach-O slice.

document.description: Exact documents[].relative_path; selects rows whose evidence names that archive.

name_sha256.description: Framed nominal namespace/name/enclosing-name digest, independent of build-local rows. Null for historical Evidence or unresolved nesting; defining assemblies and CLR runtime identity are not established.

enclosing_type_token.description: Observed enclosing TypeDef from NestedClass; null when no enclosing entry was available, which alone does not establish top-level identity.

il_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the raw il_size CIL bytes; excludes the method header, locals signature, alignment, and extra sections

normalized_il_sha256.description: Member-result-v1 SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON [opcode, operand_kind, operand] tuples for a complete decode; retains build-local tokens, omits switch targets, and excludes headers, locals, and exception regions

class_token.description: Raw build-local catch type token; not a cross-artifact identity

class_type_name_sha256.description: Nested nominal TypeDef/TypeRef name digest; assembly scope is compared separately and local tokens are not cross-artifact identities

class_type_identity_resolved.description: Whether this artifact's local token identifies the reported catch type; null when unexamined

parent_name.description: Name of a TypeDef, TypeRef, or generic-instantiation TypeSpec parent; null for other parents or when unknown

target_identity_sha256.description: Nominal declaring-type/name/signature digest; null when unresolved or unrecorded. Does not establish assembly or runtime binding.

target_name.description: Method name; a method-spec target reports its generic method

target_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the called method; null when unknown

target_identity_sha256.description: Nominal declaring-type/name/signature digest; null when unresolved or unrecorded. Does not establish assembly or runtime binding.

field_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the accessed field; null when unknown

value.description: Decoded UTF-16 code units, excluding the terminal flag byte; unpaired surrogates are kept

shared_bytes.description: PTX: entry-local declared static bytes; CUDA ELF: allocated section bytes; AMDGPU: group_segment_fixed_size. Runtime dynamic/module shared allocations are not established by PTX.

declaring_type.description: Enclosing TypeDefinitionIndex derived from nestedTypes; -1 means no enclosing metadata type was recorded
Declared TypeDefinitionIndex from this MethodDefinition; -1 is an absent reference

path.description: Selected artifact path, or the canonical resource root when resource-only Evidence has no executable subject.

__schema34.description: One-based lines, zero-based UTF-16 columns; start inclusive, end exclusive.

__schema106.description: Primary origin, as the environment manifest selects it.

__schema114.description: JSON pointer to the entity object or array within the response: the root or one member, or for an item the element of a one-element array there (/0 or /<member>/0).

__schema115.description: Ordered fields the view shows of each entity.

__schema118.description: Latest init record per request line that the view reproduced from the state.

__schema120.description: Top-level members minted per response, such as a request id: a UUID or clock that differed on every repeat of every concrete path the view answers with no write between. Checks leave them out; serving keeps the recorded value, so a served response repeats it.

__schema122.description: How the view spells clock fields it always spells otherwise than the entities' stored values; a stored value the view never recorded is spelled this way.

__schema125.description: The keys the view shows of object fields it always shows with fewer keys than an entity stores, such as a parent listed without its own nested type; a stored object the view never recorded shows those keys.

__schema127.description: Fields whose string arrays the view lists in code-point order, whatever order they were written in; learned from a read that shows a written array sorted.

__schema129.description: Recorded reads left to replay: they asked for some fields only (`fields`, `select`), or show the entities in another representation than the checked lines (an augmenting or reducing query). Replayed calls do not show served writes.

__schema131.description: Query keys that pick calls of the replayed reads out: a parameter only they name, a value only they give a parameter, or (absent) a parameter every checked line names and they leave out. A call matching any key replays; a projection parameter's value is tested on its own: a call replays unless every value it gives is `*` or one a checked line gave, and no replayed read gave it.

parameters.description: What each query parameter does. A call whose every parameter has a role is answered by evaluating them over the state.

record_ordinals.description: Checked lines the query reproduces, answered by evaluating it.

totals.description: Observed envelope members with reproducible counts of every match before paging, named as counters are; absent or unknown representations stay recorded.

field.description: Entities whose field equals the value as text, or whose array field holds it directly or as an object's id, slug or name.

fields.description: Entities with a string field containing a plain substring value, ignoring case using Unicode simple case folding; an empty value matches every entity. Syntax-like operators replay instead.

oneOf.description: Orders by the field the value names (`name`, `-name`, `name:desc`, `name-ASC`): numbers by value, text ignoring case, null last ascending.
asc or desc for the sort parameter.
Page size; zero or a negative value lists every match.

first.description: The first page, 0 or 1, when recordings distinguish the convention.

values.description: Recorded values that change nothing the view lists; other values are not computed.

target.description: The entity type an entity effect writes, or the document view a document write changes.

exemplar_ordinal.description: The first successful recorded call the plan was built from.

observation.description: The record whose response showed the written entity or document, and a JSON pointer to it.

body.description: Body members the application stored as sent (accepted), members accepted only with their recorded value (fixed), members every call sends (required), the JSON type a later call stored an accepted member as when the observation does not show it (kinds), the member a call wraps its object in as a one-element array (envelope), and the value a create stores for an accepted member a call leaves out, as a call that left it out showed (defaults).

rules.description: How written fields get their values; unlisted fields of a created entity keep the observed value.

collection.description: For a create whose recorded values are tied to its collection, the only collection it writes to.

checked_record_ordinals.description: Later reads that reproduced from the state after this write.

address.description: How a call names its entities when its path does not end in one: the action segment after the item's id, or the body's ids as an array of one JSON `kind` or as objects carrying the id field, at the root or under `member`.

read.description: A create's later read of the entity: an item read lends fields the response lacks and its clock spellings, a list read only adds fields the response lacks.

requested_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

__schema275.description: Signature type-name resolution was examined, including unresolved operands; null means no attestation, including historical or capacity-limited Evidence.

__schema277.description: Whether all NestedClass rows were read and valid. Null for historical Evidence; false means current nesting is incomplete. Individual name digests can remain unresolved for missing, cyclic or over-deep enclosing chains.

__schema282.description: Examined zero-based MethodDef row interval before declaring-type selection; null means the row scope was not recorded. Row coordinates are build-local and cannot prove cross-build member absence for a page.

coverage.description: Coverage of ELF symbols, independent data headers, AOT kind, extents and agreeing hashes
Coverage of the bounded printable-run projection; independent of snapshot header validity

__schema336.description: Observed rows; null when facet_availability declares the facet unavailable, so no rows is not evidence of none.

__schema338.description: Observed rows; null when the dossier did not record the facet (the native facet view reports it not recorded), so no rows is not evidence of none.

__schema340.description: Observed rows; null when value_flow.available is false because native_value_flow was not recorded or the provider declared it unavailable (unknowns names which), so no rows is not evidence of none.

__schema401.description: RFC 6901 pointer in the producer's reported object.

scope.description: An omitted property name; pointer identifies its actual parent, not an invented child coordinate.

resolved_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw signature with each TypeDef or TypeRef operand replaced by that type's namespace-qualified name; equals raw_sha256 when the signature names no types. Unlike raw_sha256 it does not depend on build-local metadata rows. Null when the signature could not be decoded or names a type REA could not resolve, such as a TypeSpec.
